_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DBZkWHiqgPrYfLLav4s1vTL)_

## What changed

One file, one item: `access-security.platform-owner-email-anchor` in `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/access-security.json`, revision 7 → 8, with one `history` entry naming this card and PR #24463.

Clause 6 named its own re-author trigger: "The single half's own fate is #11979's (Choice 4B): if that lands, this clause is re-authored, not read as a regression". It has landed, in two steps:

- PR #24373 (`b2e78701f7`) landed #11979. The `single` first-user promotion writes its `admin_full_access` grant with `organization_id` set to the Default Organization (`bootstrap-platform-admin.ts`, ADR-0131 D5).
- PR #24872 (`94842bad2a`, 2026-10-20, after this card was filed) removed the organization-less arm from `grantAnchorsPlatformStanding`. Under `single`, only the Default Organization's grant anchors standing now. An organization-less row anchors nothing on any posture, and it no longer applies in any resolution.

So the live door the seeded admin's 200 goes through is the Default Organization's grant. Six texts still named the organization-less row as that door. Each one is re-described below. The four the card names are first.

| field | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| `personas[0]` | "grant-anchored via the unscoped admin_full_access row that first-registrant promotion writes, the ADR-0068 D2 contrast; under a walled posture no such row is written" | "grant-anchored via the admin_full_access grant that first-registrant promotion writes, owned by the Default Organization (ADR-0131 D5), the ADR-0068 D2 contrast; an organization-less admin_full_access row anchors nothing on any posture; under a walled posture no such grant is written" |
| `fixtures.knownGaps[0]` | "also holds the unscoped admin_full_access grant under single (the posture this item boots)" | "also holds the Default Organization's admin_full_access grant under single (the posture this item boots; ADR-0131 D5)" |
| `acceptance[0].clause` | "under single the ADR-0068 D2 unscoped-grant anchor stays the only door" | "under single the ADR-0068 D2 stored-grant anchor — the Default Organization's admin_full_access grant (ADR-0131 D5) — stays the only door" |
| `acceptance[5].clause` | "standing resting on the unscoped admin_full_access grant alone still resolves PLATFORM_ADMIN (clauses 1 and 3 observe it live); under a walled posture … the same row confers no PLATFORM_ADMIN standing (the held set still grants its own capabilities; …" | "standing resting on the admin_full_access grant first-registrant promotion writes — owned by the Default Organization (ADR-0131 D5) — alone still resolves PLATFORM_ADMIN (clauses 1 and 3 observe it live as the seeded admin's 200); an organization-less admin_full_access row anchors nothing on any posture; under a walled posture … the same grant confers no PLATFORM_ADMIN standing (the held set still grants its own capabilities in its own organization; …" |
| `variants[6]` | "walled posture — the unscoped admin_full_access grant alone confers no PLATFORM_ADMIN standing (unit pin, clause 6)" | "walled posture — the Default Organization's admin_full_access grant alone confers no PLATFORM_ADMIN standing, and an organization-less row anchors nothing on any posture (unit pins, clause 6)" |
| `source[2]` parenthetical | "(#11663 L5 — the unscoped admin_full_access row derives PLATFORM_ADMIN only when the requested posture enforces no wall)" | "(ADR-0131 D5 + #11663 L5 — the Default Organization's admin_full_access grant derives PLATFORM_ADMIN only when the requested posture enforces no wall; an organization-less row anchors nothing)" |

Also changed:

- `acceptance[5].verify` and `automated.ref` now cite the describe `` '[ADR-0131 D5] under `single` the Default Organization's admin_full_access grant is the anchor' ``. It is measured in `packages/core/src/security/resolve-authz-context.platform-admin-config.test.ts` (at `9dc1f42d50`). Clause 6's trailing trigger sentence now records that the trigger fired and that revision 8 re-authored the clause.
- `source` gains `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/bootstrap-platform-admin.ts#readPromotionGrantOwner`, which reads the grant's owner. The gate resolves it as a declaration (987/997 symbol anchors resolved at head, the 10 others on the named residual).

## Verdicts

No clause verdict changes. M is refused at baseline, unverified and non-match. The seeded admin answers 200. A verified match confers. A malformed list fails closed. Under a wall the promoted grant confers no standing, and the config anchor still confers. The pins clause 6 cites still exist under the same names. Since PR #24872, the `[#11663 L5]` describes use a fixture of the Default Organization's grant. The new arm, "an organization-less row anchors nothing", is pinned by the last case of the `[ADR-0131 D5]` describe.

## Gates

All 13 exit 0: `check-ci-filter-parity`, `check-closing-keyword-parity` (and its `--self-test`), `check-comment-mask-corpus`, `check:doc-formula-expressions` (lint, after `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/lint...' build`), `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:driver-memory-census`, `check:gitlink-declared`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:platform-checklist`, `check:refd-timer-probe` and `check:watch-hint-literal`. The `--ran` reconciliation reads: "13 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 13 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero …)".

`pnpm check:platform-checklist` verdict: `OK — 16 areas, 329 items (324 active, 1 planned); … symbol anchors: 987/997 resolved … 18 file floors held`.

No package is touched, so no build closure, package test or typecheck is owed. CI families are read from this PR's check-runs. `docs/qa/**` publishes nothing, so this PR carries `skip-changeset`. Nothing was ablated: the diff changes QA-ledger data, not tested behaviour.

## Acceptance notes

- **Card target re-measured (PR #24872).** The card asked to keep the organization-less row's "single only, nothing under a wall" assertion, now pinned only by tests. That premise was falsified after filing. PR #24872 retired the row's `single` anchor, and the `[ADR-0131 D5]` describe pins "the organization-less row a pre-D5 promotion wrote anchors NOTHING". Keeping the old assertion would claim a capability the runtime no longer has. This PR states the current behaviour instead and does not change the item's verdicts.
- **Revision.** The card said 3 → 4, but the item was already at revision 7 (revisions 4 to 7 came from #24717, #24580, #24788 and #25018). This PR bumps 7 → 8.
- **Scope.** The card named four phrases. The same stale description also sat in `variants[6]` and `source[2]` of the same item, and both are re-described here. The file surface is unchanged. After this PR, `unscoped` appears 0 times in `access-security.json`.
- The attribution block's first line is an HTML comment, which the session requires as the body's first line. That is a declared deviation from `os-dev.md`'s no-HTML-comment rule (same shape as PR #25255).
- The work was done in a linked worktree (`../objectstack-issue-24465`) on the branch the claim names, because the primary checkout's guards block edits.
